name: 3DGS Radiance Caching
definition: A caching technique for path-traced volume rendering that uses 3DGS primitives to store attenuated radiance at multiple path lengths, optimizing exponentially subsampled Gaussians from noisy path samples to achieve real-time frame rates.
summary: 3DGS Radiance Caching is a real-time variance reduction technique for volume path tracing that uses compact 3D Gaussian Splatting primitives to store cached radiance, offering a significantly smaller memory footprint than neural radiance caching.
